items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: I thought it was Scott Joplin and it’s disappeared or something

ctx.x: I’ll be darned. Well you are just — have accomplished so much in your lifetime and — you still have projects going on for the future?

Well I got a nice thing, you know I belong to the women’s New York Womens’ Music Composers thing. And every once in a while there’ll be something that a performer is looking for, and there was a piano thing that a pianist wanted. Well okay, I’ll send the thing in. And it was a rag that I wrote for a play with music called “Pan Handle” many years ago. Anyway I love rag, but I could never do anything with it. It’s a piano rag. Although one of the performers in the show ran up when I played it at the first…
I’ll bet. And I can see many moments where people are going, “Oh, I remember that, you wrote that?”
